_comment: Light thrown by effects. Cosmetic only. See doc/EffectLights.md.

projectiles._comment: Sustained lights, on screen for a whole flight and often several at once. Warm or near-white reads as light. A saturated hue may read as a color filter over the ground. ELECTRONIC has no entry because its weapons span both weapon classes and take their color from that instead.

weapon._comment: An entry here overrides the subclass table for one weapon, keyed by its id in weapons.json.
